resources.string: Car mode when my car connects
Opens Car mode and starts the music when your car\'s Bluetooth connects. If Ampli is in the background, you get a notification to tap instead. Works while Ampli is open or paused in the notification.
Connect your phone to your car\'s Bluetooth once while Ampli is open, then pick it here.
Pick your car so earbuds and speakers don\'t open Car mode.
